title: Polynomial-Time Modular Evaluation
statement: The function that takes a bit string $z$, initializes the encoded gate-evaluation state from $z$, iterates the gate-state update for the prescribed number of rounds, and returns the resulting value modulo the encoded modulus is polynomial-time computable: there are a deterministic Turing machine with finitely many states and constants $C,c\in\mathbb{N}$ that, on every input of length $n$, halts within $C(n+1)^c$ steps and outputs this function's value.
